name: hellotalk-workspace
description: HelloTalk Open-Core Platform (Angular v22 + NestJS + Supabase + Centrifugo + LiveKit)

scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:check:frontend && npm run lint:check:backend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.verify: npm run check:constitution && npm run lint:check && npm run build && npm test && node scripts/check-conflict-markers.mjs && cd backend && npm run verify
scripts.verify:node: node --version && npm --version && echo '✅ Node.js and npm verified'
scripts.prepare: if [ -d .git ]; then npx husky || true; fi
